# minarank studio

> Somebody is searching for what you sell right now. We make sure they find
> you on Google, on the map, and in what ChatGPT says. Durres, Albania.

We publish this file because it costs nothing. No major provider has been
shown to read one, and we say so on the AI search page rather than selling
llms.txt as a ranking trick. It is a map, not a ranking factor. If nothing
ever fetches it, we have lost one file and no reader has lost anything.

These are the English pages. Every one of them is mirrored, record for record:
Italiano at /it/, Shqip at /sq/. Every URL on the site, in all 3 languages and
with its hreflang alternates, is in https://minarankstudio.com/sitemap.xml.

## Home
- [minarank studio · digital presence for small businesses in Durres](https://minarankstudio.com/): Somebody is searching for what you sell right now. We make sure they find you on Google, on the map, and in what ChatGPT says. Durres, Albania.

## What we do
- [Getting found on Google](https://minarankstudio.com/seo/): SEO and local search for small businesses: your Google Business Profile, on-page work on the site, and off-page work everywhere else. English, Italian and Albanian.
- [Getting named when someone asks an AI](https://minarankstudio.com/geo/): AI search, sometimes called GEO. Becoming one of the few businesses an assistant names when a customer asks it for a recommendation.
- [Websites in Albania, built to be found and to sell](https://minarankstudio.com/web-design/): Websites for small businesses: fast, clear, readable by machines, usually in three languages. Built without frameworks or third-party scripts.
- [Facebook and Instagram ads](https://minarankstudio.com/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram advertising for small businesses. A flat monthly fee, never a percentage of what you spend.
- [Custom business software for small shops](https://minarankstudio.com/systems/): Stock, jobs, customers and money in one place. We build the software small shops and trades actually run on, in Albania and Italy.

## Work
- [Work](https://minarankstudio.com/work/): Four businesses in Albania and beyond, what we built for each, and the one result with published numbers behind it.
- [Iglisi Watch](https://minarankstudio.com/work/iglisi-watch/): A family watch shop in Durres with no website at all. Three months after launch Google was sending it 560 clicks a quarter, from a standing start.
- [Victoria Boutique](https://minarankstudio.com/work/victoria-boutique/): A Durres boutique bringing Greek labels into Albania. The owner adds new pieces from her phone, in three languages, with no monthly fee and nobody to call.
- [Intimo Bruna](https://minarankstudio.com/work/intimo-bruna/): A Durres lingerie shop selling through WhatsApp, in Albanian, Italian and English, on a hand-built site with its own fonts and no third-party scripts.
- [ProAffy](https://minarankstudio.com/work/pro-affy/): Lead generation for heating and cooling firms. A site built around speed of response rather than looks, because that is what decides who gets the job.

## Blog
- [Blog](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/): What we have learned doing search, AI search and custom software for small businesses in Durres, written so you can check it.
- [How a watch shop gets found](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/watch-shops-and-jewellers/): Watch repair is an urgent local search and watch buying is a slow one. What a shop in Durres did about both, and the numbers it has after 3 months.
- [The last 4 weeks beat the first 8](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/the-last-4-weeks/): A Durres shop took 560 clicks from Google in its first quarter online, and 301 came in the last 28 days. Why search compounds, with the real numbers.
- [The menu nobody can read](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/restaurants-and-cafes/): Most restaurant menus are pictures or PDFs, so no search engine can read a single dish on them. What that costs, and what to do instead.
- [What a new shop's first 3 months look like](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/map-listing-first/): The actual Search Console numbers from a Durres watch shop's first 3 months online, and what a local business should fix before it worries about rankings.
- [The trade that sells on the coldest day](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/heating-and-cooling-trades/): Heating and cooling demand spikes into a handful of days and the search happens on a phone, late. Why the work has to be done months before the cold.
- [Nobody searches for a mechanic](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/car-repair-and-garages/): Drivers search for a noise, a warning light or a smell, not for a garage. What that means for how a workshop should be findable.
- [What nobody can promise you about AI search](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/what-nobody-can-promise-ai-search/): A studio that sells AI search optimisation, on what the research actually shows: the misquoted 40%, the llms.txt files nobody reads, and where the real leverage is.
- [Where guests start looking has moved](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/hotels-and-guesthouses/): Fewer travellers start their hotel search on a search engine than a year ago, and more start on an agency. What that means for a small guesthouse.
- [Why lingerie sells in a conversation](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/lingerie-shops/): Lingerie customers message instead of using a checkout, because sizing needs a person. How a Durres shop built for the habit its customers already had.
- [A salon lives on the second visit](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/hairdressers-and-salons/): Why a hairdresser's real number is the return visit rather than new clients, and what that changes about the website and the booking app.
- [A boutique site that is never out of date](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/fashion-boutiques/): Why a fashion boutique's website goes stale within a season, what that costs, and how a shop in Durres keeps hers current from a phone.
- [Most patients arrive recommended](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/dentists-and-clinics/): Patients pick a dentist on recommendation far more than on search. Why that makes the website a confirmation rather than an advertisement.
- [A website in 3 languages that stays in step](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/a-website-in-3-languages/): How a Durres watch shop runs its site in Albanian, Italian and English without anybody retyping a word, and why a translation widget is not the same job.
- [The shop that updates its site from a phone](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/a-shop-that-updates-its-own-site/): Victoria Boutique in Durres adds, edits and removes stock from a phone, in 3 languages, with nothing to license and nobody to call. How that build works.
- [The job goes to whoever answers first](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/whoever-answers-first/): Why trades lose jobs they paid to find: the enquiry goes to 3 firms and the fastest reply wins. What we learned building for a heating lead business.
- [Your marketing is for sellers](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/estate-agents/): An estate agent's real competition is for the instruction, not the buyer. What that changes about where the marketing money goes.
- [The 4 money lines that were really 5](https://minarankstudio.com/blog/four-lines-that-were-five/): How a watch shop's own software came to add up 4 money lines when there were 5, why no test caught it, and what that means for a business run on a spreadsheet.

## Studio
- [How we work](https://minarankstudio.com/studio/): How we work: evidence before opinion, one plain document, built in house, and the things we will tell you for free even when it costs us the job.
- [Free website audit](https://minarankstudio.com/start/): Send us your site and get a free audit back: what is costing you customers, what to fix first, and what it would cost. Or email, WhatsApp, or ask for a short call.
- [What the words mean](https://minarankstudio.com/glossary/): Plain definitions of the search and web words this studio uses: SEO, GEO, ranking, map listing, times shown, click rate and the rest. Written for shop owners, not agencies.
